answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Every claim climbs the vertex of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the kernel re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reset on any identity-link attempt, rewards vest against future work. Reaching the comet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
